title: Validation, Error Handling and API Testing
description: Bean Validation on requests, global error handling and standard ProblemDetail error responses (the S9 required lab and the FT5 project brief), then API testing with @MockitoBean and MockMvc and debugging a failing request.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S9-S10.
S9 carries calendar requiredLab true: the planned module coding lab (Standard lab overlay) is required there; S10 is a Concept day with no lab overlay.

FT5 (calendar Lab, requiredLab true) is presented on the Fast track as Project implementation: its four rows map 'shared' to their canonical topics and to the project brief error-handling-project (row 3, logging, lives in integration-and-observability).
Fast mapping: FT4 row 4 (MockMvc), FT5 rows 0-2 and FT6 rows 5-6 map here.
